paragraphs: Posted by Lily. This week, the Explorers shared two emails from our pen pals in Singapore. Ravi wrote the first email to Leo, and Alex wrote the second email to Tom. Both boys wrote about a hobby, and both emails are short. Find the same facts and the different facts.

Dear Leo, My hobby is cooking, and last Sunday I baked a cake with my dad. It was a banana cake, and it is my favorite dish. I read recipes every week, and I write the best ones in a small notebook. First, I mixed flour, eggs, and bananas in a big bowl. Then my dad put the bowl in the oven. Our kitchen is small, but we like it.

The cake baked for forty minutes, and the kitchen smelled sweet. When it was ready, I wanted to cut it immediately. "Wait, it is too hot," said my dad. The cake was soft inside and brown outside. We waited for ten minutes, and then we put cold cream on the top. My mom took a selfie of the three of us with the cake. She used her phone, and I will send it to you. We all ate a big piece, and it was very good. Do you cook at home? Your friend, Ravi.

Dear Tom, My hobby is surfing, and I surf at a beach on Saturdays. I started surfing one year ago. Last Saturday, I had a lesson with my older sister and a coach. My sister is twelve, and she likes the waves too. First, the coach showed us how to stand on the board. Then we carried our boards into the water. The water was warm and green, and many other children were in it too.

The waves were small, and I fell into the water many times. Each time, I climbed on the board immediately. After one hour, I stood up for ten seconds! After the lesson, my mom took a photo of my sister and me on the sand. She used her phone, and I will send it to you. I was tired, but I was very happy. I want to surf again next Saturday. Do you like water sports? Your friend, Alex.
Now look at the two emails again. Which facts are the same, and which facts are different?
